_about: Inputs for npm --prefix provider run measure. These are the guided demo's four scenario notes, needed for the demo and its recorded e2e cassettes. The larger generated benchmark lives in scripts/gen-cases/generated-cases.json (npm run measure:generated); see scripts/gen-cases/README.md. `expected` is an authored synthetic reference, not clinician-validated; `highlight` is a substring of the sentence a reader expects highlighted, or null when no sentence gives a dose.
